int_name: W HUNTING PARK AVE & WISSAHICKON AVE

result.summary: The intersection is a wide, car-centric environment with significant pedestrian exposure due to long crossing distances and faded pavement markings. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks, pedestrian signals, and a bus shelter are present, the overall design lacks modern safety features like curb extensions or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to motorists and failing to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and left-side roadways.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway creates a long, unprotected exposure time for pedestrians crossing the main thoroughfare.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with high-visibility continental-style crosswalks to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and reduce the speed of turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection features a very wide roadway with no visible pedestrian crossing markings or signalization across the main thoroughfare. Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic with minimal protection or designated space, creating a hostile environment.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks across the wide main thoroughfare, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians crossing without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main road in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large truck parked near the corner may block the view between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the commercial building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the large crossing distance and wide turning radii increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner curb area near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks in the asphalt near the crosswalk could present minor trip hazards or uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface within and near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the wide crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility marked crosswalk and curb ramps adjacent to a large industrial building. However, the environment lacks pedestrian-scale amenities like dedicated signals, greenery, or traffic calming measures, creating a somewhat desolate and exposed crossing.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where signals would typically be mounted.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway and lack of vertical elements like trees may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the road and to visually narrow the street, encouraging slower speeds.
